name: Suniel Shetty
bio:
​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.  

Suniel Veerappa Shetty ( born 11 August 1961) is an Indian film actor, producer, hotelier and liquor and fashion boutique owner. He is mainly active in Bollywood. He was born in Mulki, near Mangalore.

Description above from the Wikipedia article Suniel Shetty licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
